summary: Retested the PlayByPlayModal watchdog auto-advance fix on the WSH@CBJ recap episode. Confirmed the 8s watchdog is functional: after clicking Next past Goal 1, the modal did not remain stuck on a 'Video unavailable' frame — the clip index advanced automatically over the 10.5s observation window (from Goal 4 to Goal 7). Modal close via X button also works.

issues: Multiple goal clips (Goals 4 and 7 observed) are 'Video unavailable' YouTube embeds. Watchdog gracefully advances past them but the last clip (Goal 7) is also broken, so the user lands on a 'Video unavailable' terminal state at the end. Consider filtering the goal list to only include playable YouTube IDs, or replacing broken IDs in the seed data.

action_items: Data quality: Audit the WSH@CBJ episode's goal clip YouTube IDs — several return 'Video unavailable'. Replace or filter broken embeds so the user isn't left on a dead-end frame at the last clip (watchdog can't advance beyond last).
critical_code_review_comments: Watchdog fix in PlayByPlayModal.jsx behaves correctly for mid-list broken clips. Consider adding a fallback UI for the terminal case (last clip is broken) — e.g., auto-close the modal or show a friendly 'end of highlights' state instead of leaving the YouTube error frame visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_9 confirmed the 8s watchdog auto-advance in PlayByPlayModal works. Only outstanding concern is that the LAST clip of the WSH@CBJ episode is also a broken YouTube embed, so the watchdog has nowhere to advance and the modal shows 'Video unavailable' until user closes.
